## CookieExpiryInfo.clockSkewMs property

[CookieExpiryInfo.storedAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.storedat.md) minus [CookieExpiryInfo.localClockAt](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.localclockat.md) in milliseconds: the server-time correction that was applied when storing the cookie. A large absolute value indicates the local clock disagrees with the server clock. `null` if the cookie was never stored with recording enabled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
clockSkewMs: number | null;
```
